analyst.summary: Indegene provides technology and commercial-services support to pharmaceutical and biotech companies, and has posted very strong recent revenue growth (57% YoY in the latest quarter). The concerning counterpoint is that profit has not kept pace -- margins have compressed from over 20% to around 16%, and trailing twelve-month profit growth is actually negative despite the strong revenue growth. We rate it a Hold: real top-line momentum, but a genuine, unresolved question about whether that revenue is currently profitable enough, and the stock's recent underperformance suggests the market shares this concern.
